name: Single-Arm Overhead Tricep Extension
instructions: Hold a dumbbell overhead with one arm fully extended.
Lower the dumbbell behind your head by bending only the elbow.
Keep the upper arm vertical and still.
Extend back to the top. Stretches the long head under load.
longevityNotes: Pressing keeps shoulders useful, but joint-friendly volume beats grinding maxes. Full range, controlled tempo, and balanced pulling keep the shoulders healthy for decades.
overview: A beginner dumbbell press-pattern exercise targeting the triceps. Single-Arm Overhead Tricep Extension builds the upper-body pushing strength used in everything from getting off the floor to overhead reaching.
